title: I'm still amazed that AI can "build" a whole damn car from just a cube
author: spacespacespapce

comments.author: spacespacespapce
comments.body:
I’ve been messing around with a new concept where the AI actually has to use Blender tools—like extrude, inset, and loop cuts—to "build" the model step-by-step, instead of just running it through a mesh gen process.

The GIF is the raw, time-lapsed output. I love that it mimics a real artist's workflow.

The better it gets at using proper tools, the better the topology in the final .blend file.

**Curious what you guys think—what’s the craziest asset you’d want to see built this way?**
